title: kith-peer: outbox serially processes entries — one slow peer blocks all subsequent deliveries in same tick
description: outbox_tick iterates the due entries with a for loop and awaits each client.deliver_msg call sequentially. A single peer with a 30s TCP connect timeout will hold up all other pending deliveries in that tick. If there are N slow peers, the tick takes N*30s. This covers the broader serial-processing architecture that makes any slow peer block all others.
